name: com.origuma.easytoon-urp
description: High-quality Toon character shader for URP. BaseMap-first workflow with baked map enhancement (AO / Shade Normal / Hair Flow / Face SDF). Features double shadow with hue control, cel specular, angel-ring hair highlight, screen-space depth rim light, hair see-through (stencil), character-dedicated self shadow, and live-stage operation support.
